how_it_works.title: How It Works
how_it_works.step1_desc: Browse our wide selection of campervans and use filters to find your perfect match
how_it_works.step2_desc: Connect directly with verified sellers and arrange a viewing
how_it_works.step3_desc: All vans are WOF verified with optional buy-back guarantee

how_it_works_modal.title: How it works
how_it_works_modal.subtitle: Buy or sell your campervan in 3 simple steps
how_it_works_modal.step1_buyer_desc: Search campervans by location, price, features. Use filters like Self-Contained, Buy-Back guarantee, WOF/REGO validity.
how_it_works_modal.step2_buyer_desc: Found the perfect van? Send a message directly to the seller to arrange a viewing.
how_it_works_modal.step3_buyer_desc: Meet the seller, inspect the van, check documents, and complete the transaction safely.
how_it_works_modal.step1_seller_desc: Click 'Sell your van', add photos, describe your campervan. It's 100% free!
how_it_works_modal.step2_seller_desc: Interested buyers will message you directly. Respond quickly!
how_it_works_modal.step3_seller_desc: Meet the buyer, finalize the sale, and enjoy your payment.
pro_tips_list: Look for Self-Contained vans to freedom camp legally
Check WOF (safety) and REGO (registration) expiry dates
Buy-Back guarantee = seller buys it back when you leave NZ
Use our Buyback Calculator to estimate your costs
